book.name: SOHN
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sises Kamwahwihala Ohl emen me Ipwidihte Maskun
Eri, ni Sises eh ketiket kohla, e ahpw mahsanihada ohl emen me maskun sang ni eh ipwidi.
Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw kalelapak, “Maing Sounpadahk, dipen ihs me kahrehiong ohl menet eh ipwidi maskun? Pein dipe, de dipen eh pahpa oh nohno?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kaidehn dipe, de dipen eh pahpa oh nohno, me kahrehiong eh maskun. Ahpw e maskun pwe en kasalehda manaman en Koht.
Kitail uhdahn pahn nantihong wiewia doadoahk en ih me ketin kadariehdo isaneki eh rarahnte; pwe pwohng kerendohr, ahnsou me sohte emen kak wia doadoahk.
Erein ei pahn mihmi nin sampah, ngehi me kamarainpen sampah.”
Ni eh mahsanih mepwukat, e ahpw ketin kendipiong nan pwehl, oh wiahkihda pwelmatak. Eri, e ahpw ketin iriski pwelmatako pwoaren mesen ohlo,
oh ketin mahsanihong, “Kohla epwinek nan lepin Lehen Siloham.” (Ahd wet wehwehki “Pekederla.”) Ohlo eri kohla epwinek nan lepin leho, ahpw pwurodo oh kilangada wasa.
Eri, mehn mpe ko oh irail me kilangehr ohlo ni eh wia pekipek mahso, re ahpw idek, “Kaidehn ih ohlo met me kin mwomwohdete wie pekipeko?”
Ekei ahpw nda, “Iei, ih men.” A pil ekei nda, “Soh! Kaidehn, a mwomwe duwehte ohlo.” Pein ohlo eri nda, “Iei, ngehi ohlo.”
Re ahpw idek reh, “Ia duwen pwoaren mesomw kan eh pehdpeseng?”

E ahpw sapeng, “Ohl me adaneki Sises wiadahr pwelmatek oh iriski pwoaren mesei kat, oh e pil mahsanihong ie, ‘Kohwei Siloham oh epwinek ie.’ Ngehi eri kohla, oh ni ahnsowohte me I epwinek, I kilangada wasa.”
Irail ahpw idek, “Ia ih?” A e sapeng, “I sehse.”
Parisi ko Kapeidek me Kehlailadahro
Eri, re ahpw kahrelahng ohl me maskuno rehn Parisi ko.
Rahno, rahnen Sapad, me Sises wiadahr pwelmatak oh kapehdangkipeseng pwoaren mesen ohlo.
Parisi ko pil pwurehng idek rehn ohlo duwen eh kilangada wasa. E ahpw ndaiong irail, “Ohlo ketikihong pwelmatak ni pwoaren mesei kat, ngehi eri epwinek oh kilangada wasa.”

Ekei Parisi ko ahpw nda, “Ohl me wiadahr met sohte pwarodo sang rehn Koht, pwehki eh sohte peikiong kosonned en rahnen Sapad.” A pil ekei nda, “Ia duwen aramas dipan emen, eh kak wia soangen manaman duwehte met?” Irail eri liaktohrohrpeseng nanpwungarail.
Parisi ko eri pwurehng kalelapak rehn ohlo, “Ke nda me e kapehdpesengehr pwoaren mesomw kan. Eri, dahme ke ndahki duwen ohlo?” E ahpw sapengkin irail, “Soukohp emen ih.”
Me lapalap en mehn Suhs ako ahpw sohte men kamehlele me e maskun mahs, ahpw kak kilangada wasa mwuhr. Irail eri ekerodo eh pahpa oh nohno,
oh kalelapak rehra, “Noumwa pwutak menet? Kumwa kin nda me e ipwidi maskun? Eri, ia duwe eh kak kilangada wasa ahnsou wet?”
Eh pahpa oh nohno eri sapengkin irail, “Se ese me ih nait pwutako met, oh se pil ese me e ipwikihwei eh maskun.
A se sehse ia duwen eh kak kilangada wasa ahnsou wet, de ihs me kapehdpesengehr pwoaren mese kan. Kumwail idek reh, pwe mie eh lamalam oh e kakehr pein sapeng kumwail!”
Seme oh ine koasoia mepwukat pwehki ara masak me lapalap en mehn Suhs ko, pwe re pwungkipenehr ma emen pahn kadehde me iei Sises Mesaia, re pahn kihsang nan arail sinakokeo.
Ihme kahrehda seme oh ine ndahki, “Mie eh lamalam, kumwail idek reh!”
Irail eri pwurehng ekerodo ohlo keriapak, ohlo me ipwikihwei eh maskun, re ahpw ndaiong, “Inoukihda mwohn Koht me ke pahn lokaia mehlel ong kiht! Se ese me ohl dipan emen me kamwawihiukalao.”
Ohlo ahpw sapeng, nda, “I sohte ese ma ih me dipan emen de soh. Ahpw meteieu me I ese, me mahso I uhdahn maskun, a met I kilangadahr wasa.”
Irail eri kalelapak, “Dahme e wiahiong uhk? Ia duwen eh kapehdpeseng pwoaren mesomw kan?”
E ahpw sapengkin irail, “I ndaiongkumwailehr, a kumwail sohte men rong. Dahme kumwail pil men pwurehng rongki? Mwein kumwail pil men wiahla nah tohnpadahk!”
Irail eri kapailoke oh nda, “Kowe nah tohnpadahk, a kiht sapwellimen Moses tohnpadahk!”
Se ese me Koht ketin mahseniong Moses; a lahpo, se sohte ese wasa me e kohdo sang ie!”
Ohlo ahpw sapengkin irail, “Meid kapwuriamwei met! Kumwail sehse wasa me ohlo kohdo sang ie, a e kapehdpesengehr pwoaren mesei kat!
Kitail ese me Koht sohte kin ketin karonge me dipan akan; a e kin ketin karonge me kin wauneki oh wia soahng kan me e kin kupwurki.
Sang nin tepin kawa, sohte emen me rongehr me mie emen kapehdpeseng pwoaren mesen me maskun sang ni eh ipwidi.
Ma ohl menet kaidehn sang rehn Koht, e sohte kak wiahda mehkot.”
Irail ahpw sapengki, “Ke ipwidi oh kekeirda nan dihp, ke ahpw songosong en padahki kiht?” Irail eri kausasang nan sinakokeo.
Maskun ni Pali Ngehn
Ni Sises eh mwahngihada me re kausalahr ohlo, e ahpw ketin tuhwong oh mahsanihong, “Ia duwe, ke pwoson Nein-Aramas?”
Ohlo ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, komw ketin mahsanihong ie ihs ohl menet pwe I en kak pwosonla!”
Sises eri mahsanihong, “Ke kilangehr, oh iei ih me koasoakoasoiong uhk met.”
Ohlo ahpw patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, I pwosonlahr!” E ahpw kelepwikihdi mwohn Sises.
Sises ahpw mahsanih, “I kodohng sampah pwe I en wia kopwung; pwe me maskun kan en kilangada wasa, oh irail me kilangehr wasa en maskunla.”
Ekei Parisi ko, me mihmi wasao, rong eh mahsanih mepwukat, re ahpw kalelapak, “Ia duwen kiht, se pil maskun?”
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ma kumwail uhdahn maskun, sohte pahn dipamwail; a met, pwehki amwail nda, ‘Se kak kilang wasa,’ met wehwehki me dipamwail mihmiehte.”
